create_fever_dataset: create a FeverDataset instance from a JSONL data path with a HuggingFace tokenizer and max length parameters
encode_paragraph: encode a paragraph dict with title and text into tokenized tensors using the FeverDataset encode_para method
normalize_unicode_text: normalize unicode text to NFD form using the normalize function to resolve different encodings
convert_bracket_tokens: convert bracket token strings like -LRB- and -RRB- back to parentheses using convert_brc
get_dataset_item: retrieve a tokenized sample dict with question codes, start paragraph, bridge paragraph, and negative paragraph codes by index
